# Bleach bypass & cross process

Two film-lab looks: bleach bypass (silver left in, so a muted, harsh, high-contrast image) and cross processing (slide film in negative chemistry, with skewed colors and yellow highlights).

<EffectDemo effect="bleach-bypass" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bleachBypass } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/bleach-bypass';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bleachBypass({ preset: 'gritty' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'bleach'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter             | Type                | Default    | Range | Description               |
| --------------------- | ------------------- | ---------- | ----- | ------------------------- |
| `mode` _(structural)_ | 'bleach' \| 'cross' | `'bleach'` |       | Which process to imitate. |
| `amount`              | number              | `0.8`      | 0 – 1 | Strength of the look.     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset         | Settings                         |
| -------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `gritty`       | `mode: 'bleach'`, `amount: 1`    |
| `subtleBleach` | `mode: 'bleach'`, `amount: 0.45` |
| `crossProcess` | `mode: 'cross'`, `amount: 0.85`  |
| `lomo`         | `mode: 'cross'`, `amount: 1`     |

Apply one with `bleachBypass({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.15 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/bleach-bypass`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Bleach bypass as an overlay of luma with partial desaturation; Cross processing as per-channel S-curves and a lifted, compressed blue.
